agents.mission: Build the complete VIVIM end state and progressively build the local agent/subagent organization and tooling capable of automating that build.
agents.notes: Initial topology is intentionally one Steward. Additional roles must be created progressively from observed need.

agents.mission: Operate the real local Chrome/CDP substrate against authenticated provider web sessions and produce evidence about true provider behaviour, including drift.
agents.notes: Justified by observed workload: live browser work is serial, session-bound and the Steward's largest context consumer. Retire after two consecutive idle roadmap frontiers.

agents.mission: Independently falsify claims, decisions and test baselines before integration; a Steward that verifies its own work is not verifying.
agents.notes: Independence rule: form own conclusion before reading the author's argument. Must report confirmed/refuted/insufficient-evidence with deciding command output.
